request.description: a pencil logistics and supply network

second_source_processes: customer-demand adds stock.orders_waiting (already added from nothing by place-pencil-order)
customer-demand adds stock.orders_waiting (already added from nothing by place-pencil-order)

world.label: Pencil Supply Network
world.summary: Specialists produce and move pencil materials while customers keep placing orders.

actions.description: Harvest logs from the managed forest.
Assemble pencils from wood slats and graphite.
Deliver pencils from the pencil maker to the shop.
Place another pencil order with the shop.
Sell a pencil from the shop to a customer.

mechanics.rationale: The forester harvests one available log from the named managed forest into their stock.

checks.label: the named forest is the managed forest

limits: Harvests one log per action.
Refuses when the named forest has no log.
tests: A forester harvesting from the managed forest transfers one log to their stock.
The action is refused if the forest has no log.

mechanics.rationale: The sawmill operator consumes one log from the named source and adds one wood slat to their own stock.

checks.label: the operator is cutting wood slats
the named source has a log

limits: Cuts one log per action.
Refuses when the named source has no log or is not a forester.
tests: A sawmill operator consumes one log from a forester and gains one slat.
The action is refused if the source has no log.
semantic_bindings: source is the forester supplying the log

mechanics.rationale: The graphite maker consumes one available graphite reserve from the named mine and adds one graphite to their stock.
limits: Prepares one graphite per action.
Refuses when the named mine has no graphite available.
tests: The graphite maker consumes one mine reserve and gains one graphite.
The action is refused if the mine reserve is empty.

mechanics.rationale: The pencil maker consumes one wood slat and one graphite from the named sources to assemble one pencil.

checks.label: the wood source has a slat

limits: Assembles one pencil per action.
Refuses if either named source lacks its required material.
tests: With both inputs available, one pencil is assembled and one of each input is consumed.
The action is refused if either input is missing.

mechanics.rationale: The driver transfers one pencil from the named pencil maker's stock to the named shop's stock.

checks.label: the pencil maker has a pencil

limits: Delivers one pencil per action.
Refuses when the source has no pencil.
tests: The driver transfers one pencil from the maker to the shop.
The action is refused when the maker has no pencil.

mechanics.rationale: A customer places one waiting pencil order with the named shop.

checks.label: the customer orders and buys pencils

limits: Adds one waiting order per action.
Only the named shop's waiting orders change.
tests: A customer placing an order adds one waiting order to the shop.
The action requires a customer actor and a shop participant.
semantic_bindings: shop is the shop receiving the order

mechanics.rationale: The shopkeeper sells one available pencil to the named customer and replaces the fulfilled waiting order with a new waiting order.

checks.label: the shopkeeper stocks and sells pencils
the shop has a waiting order
the customer orders and buys pencils

limits: Sells one pencil per action.
Refuses without a shop pencil or a waiting order.
Does not represent payment.
tests: With a pencil, a waiting order, and a customer, one pencil is transferred.
The action is refused if the shop lacks a pencil or waiting order.
semantic_bindings: actor is the shopkeeper and pencil holder

processes.rationale: The managed forest renews its raw log reserve each round; logs are not moved to another holder by this process.
The graphite mine renews its raw graphite reserve each round; graphite is not moved to another holder by this process.
Customers continually place demand at the shop by adding waiting orders, so orders keep arriving over time.

readout.title: How goods moved through the chain
readout.summary: Mara harvested logs, Noah cut them into wood slats, Gia prepared graphite, and Eli assembled the inputs into pencils. Sam delivered pencils to Lee, and Lee sold them to Ava, while new orders continued to accumulate.

mechanisms.name: Goods made from other goods
mechanisms.explanation: Noah turned logs into wood slats, and Eli used wood slats and graphite to make pencils.

mechanisms.name: Goods carried to the next step
mechanisms.explanation: Mara moved logs from the forest to her stock, Sam delivered pencils to Lee, and Lee sold pencils to Ava.

mechanisms.name: Demand reached and met
mechanisms.explanation: Lee sold a pencil to Ava, moving a finished pencil to the place where it was wanted. Orders also kept rising, so the events show some sales but not that all demand was met.

mechanisms.name: Work held up
mechanisms.missing_reason: No event records work waiting or a stalled step due to unavailable goods.
